app.title: SignCoach
event.speeding: Speeding: {max_speed_kmh} km/h where the limit is {limit_kmh}
event.possible_speeding: Possibly speeding: {max_speed_kmh} km/h where the limit is {limit_kmh}
event.stop_not_made: No full stop at the stop sign
event.stop_ok: Full stop at the stop sign
event.no_entry_possible: Possibly drove past a no-entry sign
event.speed_not_checked: Speed not checked from {from_s} s to {to_s} s
event.stop_not_checked: Stop not checked: speed unknown near the stop sign
warning.speed_not_checked: Speed could not be measured in this video, so speeding was not checked.
warning.speed_not_checked_partial: Speed could not be measured for part of the video.
warning.camera_uncalibrated: Speed is an estimate: the camera height and lens were not calibrated.
warning.low_light: The video is dark, so some signs may be missed.
warning.blurry: The video is blurry, so some signs may be missed.
warning.portrait: The video is in portrait orientation; a landscape view through the windshield works best.
warning.no_signs: No road signs were found in this video.
warning.gpx_no_overlap: The GPS track does not overlap the video and was ignored.
error.too_long: The video is longer than {max_minutes} minutes. Please upload a shorter clip.
error.not_a_video: This file is not a video we can read.
error.consent_required: Please confirm that you may upload this video.
error.queue_full: Too many videos are waiting. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.upload_incomplete: The upload is incomplete. Please try again.
error.processing_failed: Processing failed. Please try again or upload a different clip.
error.timeout: Processing took too long and was stopped.
error.not_found: This lesson or job does not exist (the link may be wrong).
voice.stop: Stop sign. Come to a full stop.
voice.stop_not_made: No full stop at the stop sign.
voice.turn_ban_violation: This turn was against the sign.
detail.speeding: Over the limit for {duration_s} s. The speed comes from the video (±{err_kmh} km/h).
detail.reason.default_limit: No speed-limit sign was seen, so the built-up-area default ({limit_kmh} km/h) is assumed.
detail.reason.conditional: The sign has a supplementary plate, so it may not apply right now.
detail.stop_not_made: Slowest speed near the sign: {min_speed_kmh} km/h.
detail.stop_ok: Slowest speed near the sign: {min_speed_kmh} km/h.
detail.ended_by.turn: The sign's zone ended at the next turn.
detail.ended_by.max_distance: The sign's zone ended after about 300 m without a turn against it.
detail.ended_by.max_time: The sign's zone ended after about a minute without a turn against it.
detail.no_entry_possible: Check the clip: the sign may apply to this road.
detail.stop_not_checked: The speed could not be measured near the sign.
ui.no_events: Nothing to report in this lesson.
detail.reason.uncalibrated: The speed is estimated from the video and this camera was not calibrated, so this is only a possible violation.
